title: A bound criterion can be satisfied only by a host that runs the control turn checkpoint
outcome: Greg has decided whether hosts without the control plane need a way to record host-minted verification evidence for a bound criterion, and the decision is either implemented or recorded as the intended limit.
acceptance: Greg's decision is recorded: keep the control turn checkpoint as the only path that mints verification evidence, or add a host-private path that does not need a turn grant
whichever is chosen, docs/features/local-work-system.md and docs/shipped.md say which hosts can satisfy a bound criterion and what the others can do (revise or waive)
disposal_reason: Decision NO (2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous): no host-private verification ingestion without control grants; TermAl hands evidence in under grants with the turn report, and a grant-less path would bypass producer/session/run/source attribution. A background-completion inability gets its own design if it materialises.
